RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel is a recognized risk factor for unconscious affinity bias and reflects poor diversity practices, but it is not definitive proof of discrimination. For senior leadership roles, banks frequently prioritize regulatory relations and stakeholder management over technical depth, which may explain the decision.

The two-week silence on feedback is unprofessional, though common. Do not cite the panel’s gender makeup immediately, as doing so without documentation may damage professional relationships. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting a constructive verbal debrief. If you suspect unlawful discrimination and consider formal action, consult an employment attorney to evaluate your legal standing before raising the panel’s composition with HR.
